import itertools, json
verts=list('abcdefghijkl')
edges=[('a','b'),('b','c'),('c','d'),('d','e'),('e','f'),('f','g'),('g','h'),('h','i'),('i','j'),('j','k'),('k','l'),('l','a'),('a','g'),('b','h'),('c','i'),('d','j'),('e','k'),('f','l'),('a','d'),('b','e'),('c','f'),('g','j'),('h','k'),('i','l')]
E=set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)
best=[]
for r in range(13):
    for S in itertools.combinations(verts,r):
        ok=True
        for u,v in itertools.combinations(S,2):
            if tuple(sorted((u,v))) in E:
                ok=False
                break
        if ok:
            best=list(S)
maxr=len(best)
print(maxr,best)
PY"
